ReleaseNotes:
Update: Updates show their progress inside SnipEX Aura (download, check, install, restart) instead of in the installer's window.
Update: Updates install faster: only changed files are written and a slow files-in-use check is gone.
Bug fix: Winter Storm: the selected snippet has the same red and glow as the selected folder.
Bug fix: Resizing or going full screen no longer restarts the aurora, the birds or the clouds.
